measureRecords.whatItDoes: Sets Urban County Council members’ salary at $59,987 a year, with adjustments for changes in the dollar’s purchasing power, starting with the term beginning January 6, 2031.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not adopt this proposed pay rule.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Requires the Urban County Council to adopt attendance and accountability expectations for its members, starting with the term beginning January 4, 2027.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Require the council to adopt these expectations.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not add this proposed charter requirement.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Requires charter review at least once every eight years by a representative group selected by lottery. Also provides for a permanent advisory body to recommend charter amendments. Applies starting with the term beginning January 4, 2027.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the charter-review and advisory-body provisions.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not adopt these proposed charter changes.
